prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: two-frame rear-view Golden Knight tactical RPG gallop sprite sheet, transparent. Use input 1 TOP ROW as original leg silhouette/motion reference; bottom row shows the erroneous previous artwork. Input 2 is the ACCEPTED side-facing knight for palette/style/identity, not orientation.
Create ONE horizontal sheet of TWO equal 128x96 logical-pixel cells enlarged crisply, no text, no labels, no grid. Both show exactly the same knight and white-gray horse from directly BEHIND, travelling UP away from camera. Spear is upright on image-right, simple gray-white and antique pale gold armor, dark neutral saddle, centered tail.
CRITICAL: both cells share EXACTLY the same horse/rider centerline at cell x=64, same body width, same scale and upper body position. No horizontal sway, no alternate single-leg stepping, no turning. Keep head, torso, horse rump, spear and tail registered in the two cells. Frame 0 must show four upper horse legs forming a FUNNEL: upper legs spread under the body, all converge inward downwards, lower legs/hooves overlap near the center at the ground. Frame 1 shows TWO visibly separated STRAIGHT vertical legs ending in planted hooves, the other two legs hidden behind them. Symmetric centered rear gallop seen in the original reference, NOT a side-view walk and NOT one leg lifted while the other is down. Keep hooves at the SAME ground line in both frames. We will add a slight vertical whole-body bob with image registration afterwards, not a horizontal shift.
SIMPLE pixel art, clean bold connected pixel clusters, about 8 flat colors total plus transparency: charcoal outline #26323b, dark neutral gray #4d5559, medium gray #7e8584, gray-white #bdc0b9, ivory #e0dece, pale desaturated gold #b5a273, shadow gold #817454, restrained skin #caac8a. Gray-white horse and pale gold rider dominate. No blue cloth, vivid yellow/orange, glossy highlights, dithering, gradients or smooth airbrush. Fully preserve horse silhouette, armor, reins, upright spear, and rider. No cast ground shadow; it will be a fixed separate layer. Leave transparent margin and never crop the spear or hooves.
